Marc Hibbert
PHOTOGRAPHER / DIRECTOR

Photographer Marc Hibbert has finely honed his craft for over a decade, capturing the essence of humanity with unparalleled skill and earning a diverse clientele along the way.

With a contemporary perspective deeply rooted in authentic photography, Marc directs his lens towards individuals, bringing a modern sensibility to his projects.
Adept in both film and digital mediums, he seamlessly integrates these genres, adding a distinctive touch to his work.

At the heart of Marc's visual language lies his meticulous process and thorough preparation, integral components of his unique style and communication. As a collaborative team player, he is recognized for his composed demeanor, fostering a welcoming and amicable working environment.

Marc's contributions extend to prestigious publications such as Italian and British Vogue, Re-Edition, Dazed, and Self Service and brand projects for the likes of Dior, Ferragamo, Gucci, Louis Vuitton, Schiaparelli and Armani.
